title: DISCOVERING LATENT CONCEPTS LEARNED IN BERT

bias_targets.methodology: Using unsupervised hierarchical clustering on BERT's contextualized word representations to discover latent semantic groups, which qualitatively revealed that female terms (e.g., Moms, Aunt) are strongly grouped with domestic job roles (e.g., housekeeper, Maid, Nanny) independent of the immediate context.

Applying unsupervised hierarchical clustering to contextualized word representations to identify latent concepts, demonstrating that the model intrinsically groups specific names by demographic or regional origin (e.g., Arab region/Muslim names) even when the surrounding context does not explicitly provide such information.
